items.title: I built an AI conversation partner to practice speaking languages
items.raw_excerpt:
Hi, I built TalkBits because most language apps focus on vocabulary or exercises, but not actual conversation. The hard part of learning a language is speaking naturally under pressure. TalkBits lets you have real-time spoken conversations with an AI that acts like a native speaker. You can choose different scenarios (travel, daily life, work, etc.), speak naturally, and the AI responds with natural speech back. The goal is to make it feel like talking to a real person rather than doing lessons. Techwise, it uses realtime speech input, transcription, LLM responses, and tts streaming to keep latency low so the conversation feels fluid. I’m specially interested in feedback about:
– Does it feel natural?
– Where does the conversation break immersion?
– What would make you use this regularly?

items.title: 独家丨小鹏副总裁、汽车互联网中心负责人魏斌休假
items.raw_excerpt: 继李力耘因身体原因暂离一线、刘先明接任自动驾驶中心负责人后，雷峰网获悉，小鹏副总裁、互联网中心负责人魏斌目前处于休假状态。 魏斌曾任高德地图产品总监，负责导航与地图产品规划。2021年底加入小鹏汽车，主导智能座舱的研发与落地。 加入小鹏汽车以来，魏斌主要负责汽车互联网中心，涵盖智能座舱、车载软件平台及相关AI能力建设。在其任内，小鹏逐步推动座舱系统从以功能为导向的“应用堆叠”，转向以算力、操作系统与模型能力为核心的底层架构升级。XPILOT 与座舱系统在底层平台上的协同，也在这一阶段被反复强调。 一位内部人士告诉雷峰网，在过去两年中，小鹏智能座舱的研发节奏明显加快，围绕高算力平台、统一软件架构以及持续 OTA 的能力建设，互联网中心承担了大量基础性工作。这一阶段的目标，并非单一产品体验优化，而是为后续AI能力在车端的长期演进打基础。 从组织层面看，魏斌所负责的互联网中心，与自动驾驶中心、整车软件平台之间存在高度协同关系。随着小鹏近年来不断强调“AI 汽车”定位，智能座舱逐渐从传统意义上的人机交互系统，演变为车端AI能力的重要载体，其战略权重也随之提升。 此前，自动驾驶负责人李力耘因身体原因暂离一线，由刘先明接任相关职务。 多位业内人士认为，这既与高强度研发周期下的个人状态有关，也反映出小鹏正处在新一轮技术与组织重构的关键阶段。 在2024年以来的多次公开表态中，小鹏汽车反复强调，将进一步聚焦核心技术、提升组织效率，并推动智能驾驶、智能座舱与整车平台的深度融合。（雷峰网）

This is the most pressing question for all industries as large models transition from technical benchmarks to practical value delivery. A hard-to-ignore reality is that over the past three years, despite rapid advancements in large model capabilities and continuously decreasing computing costs, technological progress has not automatically translated into substantial breakthroughs in enterprise AI productivity. On the other hand, for enterprises, the rapid iteration of leading models has made efforts on the model side extremely short-lived, leading more companies to opt for externally procured models. In this scenario, where does an enterprise's own moat in the AI era lie? Both questions point to the same essence: in the second half of AGI, the necessity, importance, and urgency of enterprise data governance. On January 27, Kingsoft Office held its first WPS 365 AI Collaborative Office Summit of 2026 in Shanghai, themed "From Comprehensive Knowledge to Enterprise Brain—Application Governance of High-Quality Data." excerpt_i18n.es: Actualmente, ¿cuál es el punto crítico en la aplicación de la IA empresarial? Esta es la pregunta que más preocupa a todos los sectores tras la transición de los grandes modelos desde las pruebas técnicas hacia la implementación de valor. Una realidad ineludible es que, en los últimos tres años, a pesar del rápido desarrollo de las capacidades de los grandes modelos y la continua reducción de los precios de la computación, los avances tecnológicos no se han traducido automáticamente en un avance sustancial de la productividad de la IA empresarial. Por otro lado, para las empresas, la rápida iteración de los modelos líderes hace que los esfuerzos realizados en el lado del modelo tengan una "vida útil" extremadamente corta. Cada vez más empresas optan por adquirir modelos externamente, lo que plantea la pregunta: ¿dónde está la ventaja competitiva de las empresas en la era de la IA? Ambos problemas apuntan a la misma esencia: en la segunda mitad de la AGI, la gobernanza de datos empresariales es imprescindible.

excerpt_i18n.en:
As the Spring Festival approaches, the annual "red envelope battle" has arrived as scheduled. Unlike previous years, the main players this time have shifted from mobile payments to AI assistants. On January 25, Tencent and Baidu announced their entry: Tencent's "Yuanbao" declared it would distribute 10 billion yuan in cash red envelopes, while Baidu's "Wenxin" launched a 5 billion yuan red envelope campaign. Although ByteDance has not announced any red envelope plans, its subsidiary Volcano Engine has become the exclusive AI cloud partner for the 2026 CCTV Spring Festival Gala. On January 29, media reports indicated that Alibaba's Qianwen APP will send red envelope benefits to users during the Spring Festival. The core goal of this subsidy war initiated by tech giants is to compete for the entry point to the next generation of AI interaction, channeling user traffic into their respective AI ecosystems.

In the face of the competition for AI entry points, internet giants have adopted distinctly different strategies. Baidu has chosen the path of "seamless migration." Unlike AI assistants like Doubao, Qianwen, and Yuanbao, which require separate app downloads, Wenxin is deeply embedded within the Baidu APP, which boasts 700 million monthly active users. Leveraging the national-level search scenario, users can naturally access AI functions while searching or browsing information without needing to download additional apps. Currently, Wenxin Assistant has surpassed 200 million monthly active users. For this Spring Festival red envelope campaign, Baidu's strategy is also centered on promoting Wenxin Assistant through the Baidu APP, aiming to smoothly convert traditional search users into AI users and solidify its position as a "search + AI" super entry point.

Notably, as an embedded AI, Wenxin Assistant not only integrates Baidu's ecosystem resources.
excerpt_i18n.es: Con la proximidad del Año Nuevo Lunar, la batalla anual de los sobres rojos ha llegado puntual. A diferencia de años anteriores, los protagonistas de este año han pasado de ser los pagos móviles a los asistentes de IA. El 25 de enero, Tencent y Baidu anunciaron su participación: el "Yuanbao" de Tencent declaró que distribuirá 1.000 millones de yuanes en efectivo en sobres rojos, mientras que el "Wenxin" de Baidu lanzó una campaña de 500 millones de yuanes. Aunque ByteDance no ha revelado planes de sobres rojos, su motor Volcano se ha convertido en el socio exclusivo de nube de IA para la Gala de la CCTV de 2026. El 29 de enero, informes de medios mostraron que la aplicación Ali Qianwen enviará beneficios de sobres rojos a los usuarios durante las festividades. Esta guerra de subsidios iniciada por los gigantes tiene como objetivo central competir por la entrada a la próxima generación de interacción con IA, atrayendo a los usuarios.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 2026年2月13日，除先前宣布的GPT-5（即时版、思考版及专业版）将停用外，我们还将从ChatGPT中移除GPT-4o、GPT-4.1、GPT-4.1 mini以及OpenAI o4-mini。API方面则无任何变动。
excerpt_i18n.es: El 13 de febrero de 2026, junto con el retiro previamente anunciado de GPT‑5 (Instant, Thinking y Pro), retiraremos GPT‑4o, GPT‑4.1, GPT‑4.1 mini y OpenAI o4-mini de ChatGPT. En la API, no hay cambios.
